checks=[]

    m=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ input \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \d+ output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)\n\nSame instance',text,re.S)
    print(idx, bool(m))
    gin=[[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in m.group(1).splitlines()]
    gout=[[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in m.group(2).splitlines()]
    pred=mod.transform(gin)
    diff=[(r,c,pred[r][c],gout[r][c]) for r in range(len(gout)) for c in range(len(gout[0])) if pred[r][c]!=gout[r][c]]
    checks.append((gin,gout,diff))
    print(len(gin),len(gin[0]),'diffs',len(diff),diff[:20])
